description.value:
You exhibit the qualities of your drachiri benefactor, as per the Drachiri Benefactor table. Select one trait from your Benefactor’s Elements and Energies column. You gain resistance equal to half your level to effects with that trait, and you can substitute the damage types and traits of attacks and spells with the drachiri trait or similar draconic sources with that of your chosen trait.

If your chosen trait is Vitality or Void, you deal their respective damage types, but not their healing, but if you have a healing ability or spell of the opposite type with the drachiri trait, you can substitute the type of healing to your chosen trait.

You can take this feat multiple times; each time you do, you add a new trait from your chosen Benefactor’s Elements & Energies column that you do not have.
